data.narrative:
Airbase is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Ari Rosner and Millen Anand that has raised $5M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 10 private and 2 public companies operating in the same sector and stage, including peers such as UFORCE, Singularity, and NODA AI.

Two methods were applied to triangulate fair value. Stage-progression analysis, using the $5M total raised as a proxy base and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement, implies a valuation of $12M. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables yields a $400M implied valuation, with the peer set ranging from $125M (NODA AI, Series A) to $1.0B (UFORCE, Seed). The peer-median result reflects early-stage Defense & Security sector multiples, which command material premiums to typical venture benchmarks.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $11M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $206M. This wide dispersion reflects fundamental uncertainty regarding Airbase's product-market fit, technical differentiation, and addressable market capture relative to a heterogeneous peer set. The stage-progression method anchors the conservative bound; peer multiples drive the upper bound. Key uncertainties include revenue traction, go-to-market validation, and whether Defense & Security peer multiples will persist in the current investment environment.
